items.title: Spider Holding a Blank Label
items.alt: Brown spider with eight legs peeking over a blank cream rectangular label.
items.description: A brown spider peeks over a blank cream rectangular label. Add a name or short message in the editor for personal classroom labels.

items.title: Spider beside a Heart Web
items.alt: One small spider hangs beside a simple heart-shaped web outline with a few curved cross threads, eight legs clearly separated.
items.description: One small spider hangs beside a simple heart-shaped web outline with a few curved cross threads, eight legs clearly separated. Useful for personal friendship cards.

items.title: Spider under a Leaf Parachute
items.alt: A spider floats below a single broad leaf canopy supported by two silk lines, its eight legs spread freely beneath.
items.description: A spider floats below a single broad leaf canopy supported by two silk lines, its eight legs spread freely beneath. Useful for imaginative travel stories.
